description: He wears an opaque muted purple knee-length open-front coat with narrow gold geometric woven borders over a cream long tunic with a trimmed open collar and lower hem. A narrow brown leather-looking belt has a modest buckle and hanging end. Brown trousers tuck into tall brown boots. The textured coat appears wool-like over a linen-like underlayer; exact fibers are unverified. His hands are held naturally behind the torso and hidden rather than clipped by an image edge. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
